verdict.rationale: Mercury's built-in AI assistant, Command, lets users ask in plain language about spend, trends, and GL codes and get "immediate answers grounded in your account data." AI also suggests GL codes from categorization history and auto-categorizes transactions, which covers the core of in-product AI insights and suggestions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing), evidence of proactive unprompted insights such as anomaly or trend alerts, and in-depth documentation of Command's insight capabilities.
